question:
DRAG DROP -
An engineer must shut down the Ethernet 1/2 interface when the Ethernet 4/5 interface state is down. Drag and drop the CLI commands from the bottom onto the blanks in the exhibit to implement this EEM. Not all commands are used.
theory: This applet uses a Track object to watch Ethernet4/5's state, so the track configuration itself must reference 'interface ethernet 4/5' (the interface being monitored). When EEM's 'event track 1 state down' fires, its action statements must select the other interface — 'interface ethernet 1/2' — and then issue 'shut' on it, implementing a simple dependent-interface shutdown pattern (track object → EEM track event → conditional action) without any external scripting. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 16 — Automation and Scripting Tools)
